events.description: Welcome to the Asheville Craft Beer Half Marathon – 10K – 5K! One of the greatest destination races in North Carolina just got even better. Asheville is truly an American treasure—now paired with one of the most vibrant craft beer scenes in the country. From world-class breweries and local taprooms to incredible food, arts, and mountain views, this is the ultimate run + reward experience. Runners will not only take in the beauty of Asheville but also celebrate at the finish with local craft beer from some of the area’s best breweries . This is more than a race—it’s a full Asheville experience. The Asheville Craft Beer Half Marathon – 10K – 5K begins and ends in Pack Square on August 29, 2026 . events.description: Come celebrate Beer City USA with your running buddies! Discover Asheville, North Carolina, nestled in the picturesque Blue Ridge Mountains, where clean mountain water flows and a rich beer brewing legacy thrives. Experience a beer lover’s paradise with over 30 craft breweries, making it home to some of the finest breweries in the nation. Embraced by enthusiasts, Asheville tops many must-visit lists for its exceptional brews and captivating mountain charm, attracting runners, bikers, and hikers alike. Don’t miss the highly anticipated Beer City Relay, where the spirit of running and craft beer converge. The esteemed host for this year’s event is none other than New Belgium Brewing. events.title: Biltmore Kiwanis Classic
events.description: Join us for the 27th running of the Biltmore Classic. Choose from the 5k or 15k distances. This race deserves to be on every runners bucket-list and will indeed be on every runners “best race” list. Nestled in the blue ridge mountains, the Biltmore Estate was built for George Washington Vanderbilt II between 1889 and 1895 and holds the record of being the largest privately owned house in the United States. The Biltmore-Kiwanis Classic 15k and 5k races have been running on the estate since 1997 and act as the biggest fundraiser for Asheville’s Kiwanis Club.

events.title: Conquer the Rock 25k & 50k
events.description: 🏞️ Welcome to the Mountain’s Challenge So, you wish to walk among the clouds? ☁️ Then lace up, for this journey takes you over the mighty backs of Pinnacle Mountain and the legendary Table Rock, two of South Carolina’s tallest guardians of stone. 🗻 These trails? They ain't gentle. They're steep, rocky, and relentless—but also stunningly beautiful. 🌄 Every switchback, every climb, every gasping moment rewards you with panoramic views most only dream of. And when your legs tremble at the summit, the mountains whisper: You are strong. You are worthy. 🥾 Why You’ll Love (and Respect) This Race 🐻 Bear Crawl 25k – One brutal loop 🐐 Foothills 50k – Two soul-shaping laps 🪨 16,000 feet of elevation change 🏔️ Summits of Pinnacle & Table Rock 🌲 A tight-knit tribe of trail runners to share the journey

events.description: VISIT THE OFFICIAL RACE WEB SITE FOR ALL DETAILS - www.SwampRabbitRace.com The Greenville Half Marathon & 5K is a net downhill half marathon and 5K run. The 5K starts at the Swamp Rabbit Cafe and follows the Swamp Rabbit Trail to the same finish line on the TD Stage at the Peace Center. 2027 marks the 15th running of the this great event.

events.title: GTC Paris Mountain Road Race
events.description: General Race Information The Paris Mountain Road Race 10k is a hilly run around the base of Paris Mountain starting and finishing at Redeemer Presbyterian Church at 6150 Old Buncombe Rd., Greenville, SC. The total elevation gain over the 10K distance is roughly 1500 feet. With over 2500 vertical feet of elevation gain, 89 curves, and some hills at 15% grade, the Paris Mountain Road Race 20k lives up to its billing as the TOUGHEST RACE IN THE SOUTH. The race starts at Redeemer Presbyterian Church, ascends the north side of Paris Mountain, descends on the south side, and uses the hilly back roads at the base of the mountain to return. Sorry, but strollers and dogs are not permitted in the Paris Mountain Road Races.

events.title: GTC Paris Mountain Trails 16K
events.description: This is a very challenging course as it includes the long climb to the top of the mountain as well as encompassing North Lake. Directions (for the run): Start at park entrance; Right at Mountain Creek; Left on Sulphur Springs; Continue past the pavilion and reservoir; Left on Firetower; Left on Kanuga; Left on North Lake; Left on Pipsissewa; Right on Brissy Ridge; Cross Buckhorn parking lot; Continue down Sulphur Springs; Continue on Mountain Lake; Finish at Ranger Station pavilion.

events.title: GTC Upville Mile
events.description: Why run down when you can run up ? GTC Upville Mile is a 1-mile, uphill-only road race in Paris Mountain State Park, on the steepest part of Paris Mountain State Park Road. The route is one of the toughest, if not the toughest uphill 1-mile road segments in the Upstate, including nearby Altamont Road, and the road going up Sassafras Mountain. If you like a running challenge, this event may be just the ticket for you. Don't be surprised though if you find it necessary to do at least a couple short walk breaks. It's recommended you practice on this route before you race on it. With an average grade of 8.2%, and elevation gain of 460 feet in just a mile, it surely will not disappoint. John Hart, Race Director
